channel_targets:

docker_image:

about.description:
marspylib is a pure-Python library for reading and writing Mars
MoleculeArchive (.yama) files -- no JVM, no Fiji install required. It
includes a Jackson-Smile-binary codec, an object model matching
mars-core's record schema, and utility functions for working with Mars
data in Python. Optional S3 support (opening/saving archives directly on
S3 or any S3-compatible endpoint) needs boto3, installed separately
(e.g. `pip install marspylib[s3]`, or `conda install boto3`).
about.summary: Pure-Python library for reading and writing Mars Molecule Archives (.yama)

name: marspylib
raw_meta_yaml:
{% set name = "marspylib" %}
{% set version = "0.3.0" %}

package:
  name: {{ name|lower }}
  version: {{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/{{ name[0] }}/{{ name }}/{{ name }}-{{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 75baf916be540e9bb86ed31ec33890876833802a9c9d4725b8b5f7dfc36699c0

build:
  noarch: python
  script: {{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv
  number: 0

requirements:
  host:
    - python >=3.8
    - pip
    - setuptools
  run:
    - python >=3.8
    - numpy
    - pandas
    - matplotlib-base

test:
  imports:
    - marspylib
    - marspylib.yama

about:
  home: https://github.com/duderstadt-lab/marspylib
  summary: 'Pure-Python library for reading and writing Mars Molecule Archives (.yama)'
  description: |
    marspylib is a pure-Python library for reading and writing Mars
    MoleculeArchive (.yama) files -- no JVM, no Fiji install required. It
    includes a Jackson-Smile-binary codec, an object model matching
    mars-core's record schema, and utility functions for working with Mars
    data in Python. Optional S3 support (opening/saving archives directly on
    S3 or any S3-compatible endpoint) needs boto3, installed separately
    (e.g. `pip install marspylib[s3]`, or `conda install boto3`).
  license: BSD-2-Clause
  license_family: BSD
  license_file: LICENSE.txt
  doc_url: https://github.com/duderstadt-lab/marspylib
  dev_url: https://github.com/duderstadt-lab/marspylib

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - karlduderstadt
